reviewScope: Complete lexical candidate review of configuration.js. Validation/projection errors reaching the administration panel are localizable; four legacy commercial/finish labels are deferred as editable data; schema versions, IDs, enums, colors and property names are technical.
limitations: Inventory only; configuration behavior and locale resources remain unchanged.
Dynamic schema paths and product IDs must be preserved as parameters or mapped to friendly labels later.
Legacy commercial labels require a product/content ownership decision before per-locale persistence is designed.
